definition_used: Civil legal proceedings were instigated in response to the article and/or notice(s), or civil legal proceedings resulted in the correction/EOC/retraction/etc.
caution: The reason indicates a legal process triggered by the article, but does not specify the underlying manuscript issue. It is a post-publication event that may relate to transparency or due process, but lacks direct evidence of content, authorship, or editorial problems.
semantic_rationale: Civil proceedings are a legal process external to the research content, triggered by the article or its notices. This falls under post-publication oversight as it involves legal scrutiny of the publication, but does not directly indicate issues with research content, authorship, or editorial governance.
